intro: Dockmaster Baren manages the bustling pier at Lakeshire, but finding fresh stock for his trade has grown difficult. He pays travelers to haul in spotted sunfish, a prized local staple of Lake Everstill that has become dangerous to gather due to the encroaching murlocs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish. There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!
Bring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them. If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have some sunfish for me, eh?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
